title: Replace a driver licence while temporarily interstate or overseas
summary: You can order a replacement NSW driver licence online if you are temporarily interstate or overseas and your card was lost, stolen, or destroyed. Otherwise, you must complete and post a photo-kit form.
intro:
If you’re temporarily interstate or overseas and your NSW driver licence card has been lost, stolen or destroyed, you can order a replacement licence online.

If you're unable to replace online or need the licence to be sent outside NSW, you'll need to complete a photo-kit form and send it by post. It may take 6 to 8 weeks for the form to be processed and the replacement licence sent.
who_can_apply: The licence must not be a temporary paper licence.
The licence must not be suspended or cancelled.
what_you_need: Photo-kit for a NSW Licensee Temporarily Interstate, or Photo-kit for a NSW Licensee Temporarily Overseas.
A colour passport size photograph as detailed on the form.
Proof of identity as detailed on the form.
An appropriate witness as described on the form.
Accepted change of name document as listed on the form.
If your proof of identity documents are in an old name due to a name change, you must also provide a witnessed and certified change-of-name document.

how_to_steps.text: Ensure you have a witness to complete the form if:
Attach your supporting documents, and post your photo-kit application form with payment, to the address specified on the form.

faqs.q: How long does it take to get a replacement licence?
faqs.a: If you send a photo-kit form by post, it may take 6 to 8 weeks for the form to be processed and the replacement licence sent.

faqs.q: What if I cannot replace my licence online?
faqs.a: If you are unable to replace online or need the licence sent outside NSW, you must complete a photo-kit form and send it by post.

faqs.q: Can I ask for a name change using a photo-kit form?
faqs.a: No, you cannot ask for a name change using a photo-kit form.
